crossRefs.note: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain…
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
“Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure…

translations.web: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
translations.bsb: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.
translations.kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
